name: simulador-epn
description: Simulador de admisión EPN 2026-B — Cloudflare Pages (simulador-epn.pages.dev)

scripts.predeploy: node scripts/smoke-banco-1000.mjs && node scripts/smoke-figuras.mjs && node scripts/smoke-math-prose.mjs && node scripts/smoke-sampler-coverage.mjs
scripts.dev: node scripts/sync-public.mjs && wrangler pages dev public --port 8788
scripts.deploy: node scripts/smoke-math-prose.mjs && node scripts/sync-public.mjs && wrangler pages deploy --project-name=simulador-epn --commit-dirty=true
